bodies: New York State Board of Law Examiners
Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
Committee on Bar Admissions (Louisiana Supreme Court)

exams.name: NFPA Paralegal Advanced Competency Exam
exams.blurb: A two-tier exam leading to the Registered Paralegal (RP) designation for experienced paralegals demonstrating advanced competency and ethics.

exams.name: NFPA Paralegal CORE Competency Exam
exams.blurb: An entry-level exam granting the Certified Paralegal (CRP) designation for candidates with less than two years of substantive paralegal experience.

exams.name: New York Law Course
exams.body: New York State Board of Law Examiners
exams.blurb: A free online course of approximately 15 hours covering New York practice and procedure that candidates must complete before taking the NYLE.

exams.name: New York Law Exam
exams.body: New York State Board of Law Examiners
exams.blurb: A 50-question open-book multiple-choice test of New York-specific law that candidates must pass in addition to the UBE for New York bar admission.

exams.name: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional
exams.body: Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
exams.blurb: A credential for compliance officers covering program design, risk assessment, investigation and ethics within organizational compliance functions.

exams.name: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional - International
exams.body: Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics
exams.blurb: An international variant of the CCEP focusing on anti-corruption, cross-border regulations and multinational compliance program requirements.

exams.name: AAPI Accredited Legal Professional
exams.blurb: A specialized accreditation for legal support professionals emphasizing compliance, document management and procedures within legal operations.

exams.name: Certified E-Discovery Specialist
exams.blurb: A credential validating expertise in the legal hold, collection, processing and review of electronically stored information in litigation.

exams.name: Certified Legal Investigator
exams.blurb: An advanced credential for professional investigators demonstrating proficiency in evidence gathering, surveillance and courtroom testimony.

exams.name: Certified Legal Manager
exams.blurb: A credential for law firm and legal department administrators covering finance, human resources, operations and legal industry ethics.

exams.name: Certified Legal Nurse Consultant
exams.body: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
exams.blurb: A certification for registered nurses who analyze medical records and provide expert consultation on healthcare-related legal cases.

exams.name: Certified Notary Signing Agent
exams.blurb: A Notary Public certification specializing in properly executing and witnessing mortgage and real estate loan document signings.

exams.name: California Bar Exam
exams.blurb: California’s jurisdiction-specific two-day bar exam combining state essays, performance tests and the Multistate Bar Examination for state licensure.

exams.name: Louisiana Bar Exam
exams.body: Committee on Bar Admissions (Louisiana Supreme Court)
exams.blurb: Louisiana’s civil-law jurisdiction exam using state-written essays and multiple-choice questions rather than the MBE for admission to practice.

exams.name: Certified Government Financial Manager
exams.blurb: A credential for public-sector financial professionals covering governmental accounting, auditing and financial reporting and control standards.

exams.name: Certified HIPAA Professional
exams.blurb: A certification demonstrating working knowledge of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act privacy and security rule requirements.

exams.name: Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager
exams.blurb: A banking credential for compliance managers demonstrating knowledge of consumer regulations, risk management and examination readiness.

exams.name: Certified Licensing Professional
exams.blurb: A credential for professionals who negotiate and manage intellectual property licenses, covering valuation, deal structuring and IP strategy.

exams.name: Certified Patent Valuation Analyst
exams.blurb: A specialization certifying expertise in quantifying the financial value of patent portfolios for transactions, licensing and litigation support.
